title: Design System: Señas a Voces Academy

desk.note: No longer a ground. Only the scrollbar track and the Índice backdrop at 70%.

line.note: Ring and underline color only (fields, chapter tabs, Índice close, text-link underline). No longer draws rules between content.

band-line.note: Defined but currently unused; the contact footer rule was removed.

index-title.purpose: The Índice page h2 only. Petroleum (fg in dark mode).

display.purpose: Cover h1 only. Petroleum, with the second line set as a cyan block.

statement.purpose: The scroll-revealed manifesto and the closing quote on the band. Max 18 to 22ch.

headline.purpose: Each section's h2. Petroleum on cream, max 760px. The contact h2 runs at clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 60px).

index-entry.purpose: Chapter rows on the Índice page. fg, cyan on hover, folio at 0.7em muted tabular.

quote-display.purpose: The lead testimonial over its photograph (white, max 30ch) and the featured press headline (clamp 26 to 36px, 1.18). Typographic quote marks.

subtitle.purpose: Audience terms (24px), Academy points (26px), creator names (clamp 24 to 28px), milestone labels (19px chip step).

body-lead.purpose: Sheet intros under the headline. Muted, max 56ch.

body-list.purpose: Press and partner names in plain columns, fg, each column headed in muted at the same size.

body.purpose: Running copy in muted, 36 to 48ch measures. The base is 16px at 1.6.

body-sm.purpose: Creator bios, milestone detail lines, the interpreter note. 15px at 1.5 to 1.6.

label.purpose: Buttons, header controls, status lines, text links. Sentence case, never tracked uppercase.

caption.purpose: Figure captions, roles, the chart legend. The proof strip uses 14px bold at 80% fg.

shadows.name: amber-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons at rest. Hover: 0 10px 22px -8px rgb(255 164 49 / 0.8). The contact submit shows only the hover glow.

shadows.name: phone-drop
shadows.purpose: Filter on the phone over the laptop render, so it follows the frame silhouette.

shadows.name: chapter-tab-active
shadows.purpose: The petroleum tab of the current chapter on the right-edge rail.

shadows.name: card-on-band
shadows.purpose: The contact form card on the petroleum band.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)
motion.purpose: UI state transitions at 200 to 300ms (buttons, links, fields).

motion.name: ease-rail
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)
motion.purpose: Chapter tab slide and color at 300ms; the contact submit lift at 200ms.

motion.name: index-slide
motion.value: translateY(-100%) -> 0, 500ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)
motion.purpose: The Índice dialog slides down over the page. Reduced motion: no transition.

motion.name: inertial-scroll
motion.value: Lenis duration 1.1s, easing 1 - (1 - t)^4; chapter jumps scrollTo 1.4s
motion.purpose: Page scroll and chapter jumps to each section's measured top. Not started in lite mode or reduced motion; jumps are instant.

motion.name: header-band
motion.value: opacity 0 -> 1, 300ms, once scrollY > 12
motion.purpose: Solid band in the page colour (bg, or band over contact) behind the header controls.

motion.name: backdrop-drift
motion.value: circle y 0 -> -60 to -260px across the viewport
motion.purpose: Three circles per section at separate rates; the layer does not clip, so circles cross chapter edges. Calm (lite or reduced motion): still.

motion.name: cover-depth
motion.value: cover's own scroll ['start start', 'end start']: copy -50px, lead photo -90 / block -40, second photo -170 / block -110; pointer spring stiffness 80 damping 18, far x10, near x-18
motion.purpose: Cover layers drift as it scrolls away. Pointer layer on fine pointers only. Calm (lite or reduced motion): 0 and pointer off.

motion.name: portrait-block-trail
motion.value: block y -28px -> 28px across the viewport
motion.purpose: A creator's offset block trails its photo. Calm (lite or reduced motion): 0.

motion.name: depth-image
motion.value: image 116% tall, y -13% -> 0%
motion.purpose: Photos drift inside their frames. Calm (lite or reduced motion): held at -6.5%.

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: Shared ease for title and block reveals and the portrait hover.

motion.name: title-reveal
motion.value: per word, masked: y 105% -> 0%, 0.9s ease-entrance, stagger 0.06s; once on view (margin -10% bottom) or on mount
motion.purpose: Every chapter h2 built on Sheet plays it on first view; the cover h1 plays it on mount after 0.15s with 'encuentran voz.' as the cyan line. Screen readers get the heading intact. Calm: at rest.

motion.name: block-reveal
motion.value: opacity 0 -> 1, y 28px -> 0, 0.8s ease-entrance, delay prop for stagger; once on view (margin -12% bottom)
motion.purpose: Section intros (0.2s), cover paragraph (0.55s) and CTAs (0.7s), audience rows, glove and translator text columns, creator text, community quotes and name columns. Calm: at rest.

motion.name: population-count
motion.value: 13 LSM dots: background to cyan and scale 1.1, 500ms each, 70ms apart; once when the chart is in view (margin -20% bottom)
motion.purpose: The problem chart counts its LSM share. Calm: filled at rest.

motion.name: portrait-hover
motion.value: translateY(-6px) rotate(-1deg), 500ms ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Hover feedback on creator portraits and their blocks.

motion.name: word-reveal
motion.value: per-word opacity 0.14 -> 1, scrubbed from 'start 85%' to 'end 40%'
motion.purpose: Manifesto statement. The screen reader reads the intact sentence. Calm (lite or reduced motion): full ink.

motion.name: trajectory-draw
motion.value: pathLength scrubbed from start 75% to end 92%, spring stiffness 120 damping 30; pen point at getPointAtLength(total x drawn)
motion.purpose: A solid petroleum stroke draws over the dashed path with a cyan pen at its tip. Calm (lite or reduced motion): fully drawn, no pen.

motion.name: milestone-settle
motion.value: spring 0.7s bounce 0.25 from scale 0.86, rotate ±5deg, y 22px; once, viewport margin -22% bottom
motion.purpose: Milestone media settle once on first view, transform only, never opacity. Calm (lite or reduced motion): at rest.

motion.name: render-scrub
motion.value: video.currentTime = clamp((progress - 0.12) / 0.7) x (duration - 0.05), one seek per animation frame; progress over [start end, end start]
motion.purpose: The all-intra dashboard render is driven by scroll. The clip mounts within 900px of the viewport. Lite: poster still.

motion.name: render-shutter
motion.value: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) -> inset(0) over progress 0.05 -> 0.32; video scale 1.12 -> 1 over 0.05 -> 0.4
motion.purpose: The render is uncovered from its bottom edge as it arrives. Scroll-mapped. Lite: none.

motion.name: phone-parallax
motion.value: y 140px -> -120px, rotate 6deg -> -4deg across the stage
motion.purpose: The phone rides over the laptop render at its own depth. Lite: 0.

motion.name: lesson-render-play
motion.value: muted loop, plays at 15% visible, pauses outside
motion.purpose: The lesson render plays while in view. Calm (lite or reduced motion): poster still.

motion.name: lite-mode
motion.value: saveData || deviceMemory <= 2 || hardwareConcurrency <= 2 || prefers-reduced-motion || ?lite; or median frame > 34ms over frames 10-90 after load
motion.purpose: html.lite removes every backdrop-filter and cuts transitions to 0.01ms. useLite and useCalm gate parallax, videos, springs, entrances and Lenis.

motion.name: theme-transition
motion.value: background-color, color 0.4s ease
motion.purpose: Light/dark switch on body.

narrative.overview:
The site is the team's evidence portfolio opened flat. Every chapter is a full-bleed section on one shared cream ground, and the chapters flow into each other with no cards, no rounded sheets, no gutters between them and no stacking. Cream chapters paint no ground of their own and clip nothing, so the decoration belongs to the page rather than to a chapter. The brand repeats through the portfolio cover's concentric cyan wave lines, which sit in two opposite corners of every section, and through three soft solid circles in petroleum, amber and cyan that drift behind each section's copy at their own scroll rates; both run across chapter edges with no visible cut. The page closes on one full-bleed petroleum band for contact, the only chapter with its own ground and its own clip.

Petroleum carries the voice: League Spartan titles, set heavy and tight. Cyan appears at display size, in the wave lines and as the data and trajectory marks, including the pen point that draws the trajectory. Amber is reserved for actions and small markers. Body text is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, a face built for legibility, because the audience includes deaf and hard-of-hearing readers and accessibility-focused institutions. Imagery is real and set at uneven sizes: the four creators photographed under colored light on offset blocks in their own color, the team's own drawing of the glove, a community testimonial set straight over the photograph of that work, and the team's own 3D laptop renders, whose white studio backdrop multiplies into the cream so the laptop sits on the page itself.

The density is editorial. Secondary material is set as plain text (quotes in columns, names in columns) and the column edges and the space between blocks do the organising; there are no hairline dividers between content. The header owns no box: the logo and controls sit straight on the page, and a solid band in the page's own colour appears behind them only once the page has scrolled. The page moves: chapter titles rise word by word out of a mask, and copy blocks rise into place once as they arrive, on top of the scroll-linked depth. Slow devices and reduced-motion visitors get the same page at rest, with all of that motion switched off.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed sections on one cream ground (bg), each padded clamp(88px, 10vw, 144px), with no section cards, radii, gutters or stacking. Cream chapters paint no background and do not clip; horizontal overflow is clipped once, at page level. Contact is a full-bleed petroleum band with its own ground and clip.
A chrome-free header: logo left, controls right, straight on the page. Once scrolled, a solid band in the page's own colour (cream, or petroleum over contact) fades in behind them. Never a gradient.
Petroleum League Spartan display type (700, -0.02em, line-height 0.92 to 1.02). Cyan is used only for the second line of the cover headline and for marks.
Amber pill actions; the main button carries a warm amber glow. Amber dots mark status and proof.
Concentric cyan wave lines in opposite section corners at 45% and 35% opacity, over three drifting backdrop circles at 6 to 12% opacity, all running uncut across chapter edges.
No hairline dividers between content blocks: space separates them.
Secondary content as plain type: the lead testimonial over its photograph, other quotes and press names in text columns, no card grids.
Devices are the team's own 3D renders: a scroll-scrubbed laptop that opens with a clip-path shutter, a played lesson render, and an iPhone 16 Pro SVG frame drawn over a real recording.

Motion is scroll-linked depth plus once-only entrances: Lenis inertial scroll, parallax, a word reveal, the trajectory drawing itself, the render scrub, chapter titles rising word by word from a mask, and copy blocks rising into place on first view. Lite mode and reduced motion turn all of it still.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Gray Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is a warm cream or a petroleum-tinted ink. The "Índice" backdrop is sand at 70%, never black or gray. Device hardware (the phone's titanium frame) is the one exception, because it depicts a real object. A photograph may be darkened under the type set on it (the testimonial photo at brightness 0.55); that is image treatment, not a surface.

rules.name: The Amber Means Act Rule
rules.body: Solid amber fills only things you can press, plus tiny dots that mark status or proof. It never fills a card or a band. The only other amber is the 10 to 12% backdrop circle, which is atmosphere, not a surface.

rules.name: The No-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case in bold Atkinson. The system has no tracked-out uppercase small labels and no kickers above titles. A section's title is the first thing in the section. Column headings ("Medios", "Aliados", "Reconocimientos") are set at the list's own size in muted, not as small caps.

rules.name: The Cyan Is Display-Size Rule
rules.body: Cyan text appears only at display, figure or index-entry size (24px and up). Running text stays in fg or muted.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: Sections and the things laid on them (the glove drawing, logo tiles, photographs) have no resting shadow. A shadow belongs only to something lifted off the page: a pressable button, the phone held in front of the laptop, the active tab, the form card on the band.

rules.name: The Settle, Never Hide Rule
rules.body: An object placed on the paper (milestone media) may settle once, the first time it is seen: a spring on scale, rotation and y only, never opacity. It is fully visible from first paint, it never replays, and when calm it renders at rest.

rules.name: The Rise Once Rule
rules.body: Type and copy blocks enter once, on first view, and never replay: headings rise word by word from a mask, blocks rise 28px with opacity, siblings staggered by a delay. Entrances run on the shared entrance ease (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Under calm everything renders at rest from first paint.

dos: Do build every new chapter as a full-bleed section on the shared ground: clamp(88px, 10vw, 144px) padding, a backdrop-circle layout different from its neighbors, wave lines in opposite corners, and a headline-plus-intro header.
Do register every new chapter in the chapter list so it gets a divider tab and an "Índice" entry, and route its in-page links through the section-top resolver.
Do set titles in petroleum League Spartan 700 at -0.02em. Keep running text in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, at 17px with 1.65 leading, in muted, within 36 to 56ch.
Do fill actions with amber and amber-ink in full pills that are at least 48px tall (44px in the header), and pair a primary button with an underlined text link rather than a second filled button.
Do set secondary material as plain type in columns and let photographs carry the weight, at uneven sizes; put a quotation over its photograph rather than in a card.

Do show real people, the team's own renders and drawings, and real platform recordings, shown whole. Multiply white-backdrop renders into the ground and feather their edges. Put creators on their own tone's offset block.
Do gate every parallax, video, spring, entrance and the inertial scroll on the calm check, so lite mode and reduced motion get the page at rest.
Do give new chapter headings the word-by-word title reveal and new copy blocks the once-only block reveal, staggered by a delay, on the entrance ease.
Do let cream chapters share the page's ground: no background and no clip on the chapter, so decoration crosses chapter edges uncut. Clip horizontal overflow only at page level.
Do separate rows, facts and footers with space rather than rules.
donts: Don't put sections in rounded cards, separate them with gutters, stack them or give them edge shadows.
Don't box the header: no bar, tab, pill container, gradient or blur behind the logo and controls. The only backing is the solid band in the page's own colour once scrolled.
Don't lay content in card grids (press clippings, quote cards, reach cards); set it as plain text in columns.
Don't give a resting shadow to anything laid flat on the page (drawings, logo tiles, photographs).
Don't replay entrances, tie them to every scroll pass, or let an entrance leave content hidden under calm. Milestone media keep their transform-only settle and never touch opacity.
Don't paint a background on, or clip, a cream chapter; only the petroleum band owns its ground.
Don't draw hairline rules between content rows, between blocks of a chapter or above the footer.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a section title, or use tracked uppercase small labels.
Don't set body copy or small labels in cyan. It reaches only large-text contrast on cream.
Don't fill cards, bands or large areas with solid amber.
Don't build device mockups from CSS boxes; use the team's renders or the iPhone 16 Pro frame.
Don't use colored offset blocks anywhere except behind creator portraits, and don't use them as a generic card shadow.
Don't introduce purple SaaS gradients, emoji feature cards or a hero over a row of equal feature cards.
